summary: Rensselaer County, NY 60-ft Aermotor LS40 erected 1922, in service 1923, closed after 1970 and removed; an FFLA-NY post says almost nothing is left at the site.

facts.status_note: Closed after the 1970 season and later removed; no source describes what remains on the hill

New observer's cabin built on the hill in 1923
Closed at the end of the 1970 season, as aerial detection came in

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NYSFFLA entry: erected 1922, operational 1923. Starr's list (opened year) and the January 2023 newsletter point to 1923. The story gives 1922 for erection and 1923 for service and notes that Starr's list gives 1923 as the opening year.
NYSFFLA places the hill 5 miles southeast of Averill Park; the FFLA-NY post says 'near Stephentown'. Both towns are in Rensselaer County, so the story names both as pointers.

notes_for_editor: The only statement about the site today is the title of an FFLA-NY Facebook post; the body did not load in the cache, so the post may say more (footings and a cistern were mentioned in a search snippet only; not verified and not used). Erection year conflicts: NYSFFLA says 1922, Starr and the newsletter say 1923. The January 2023 newsletter says 'Two other towers were completed in late 2022', which is probably a slip for 1922 or 1923; not quoted. Ownership and public access are unknown and were left out of the story.
